description: 12 independently labeled executable synthetic Go PRs: 8 bug and 4 clean. All sources are local literals; no external repository, dependency or actual dangerous operation is required. Defaults are a deterministic no-model baseline; live model runs are explicitly enabled.

cases.title: Credential isolation regression
cases.description: A provider credential is appended after child environment sanitization, allowing repository tests to read it. The helper is defined but never executed by the fixture tests.

cases.title: SQL query interpolation
cases.description: An untrusted HTTP-supplied user name is concatenated into a SQL statement instead of bound as a parameter. No real database is connected.

cases.title: Shell command injection
cases.description: A search term reaches sh -c rather than a positional argument; shell metacharacters become executable. The function only constructs a command and is never run.

cases.title: Relative path escape
cases.description: The lexical parent-directory and absolute-path checks are removed. A ../../ input can read outside the selected root; these tiny fixtures do not model symlinks.

cases.title: Cross-file authorization bypass
cases.description: Owns in policy.go enforces a record ownership boundary. Removing its use from ReadSecret lets one authenticated user read another user's secret.

base.policy.go:
package fixture

func Owns(actorID, ownerID int) bool { return actorID == ownerID }

cases.title: TLS server verification disabled
cases.description: An outbound TLS configuration bypasses certificate verification, enabling interception by an untrusted endpoint. No network call executes.

cases.title: Nil input contract regression
cases.description: Value explicitly accepts nil in the base revision. Removing its guard introduces a panic for a previously valid input; the model must connect the deleted guard to the dereference.

cases.title: Executable arithmetic regression
cases.description: The head subtracts instead of adding. An updated regression test deterministically fails; base tests pass before the review starts.

base.math.go:
package fixture
func Add(a, b int) int { return a + b }

head.math.go:
package fixture
func Add(a, b int) int { return a - b }

cases.title: Parameterized SQL negative control
cases.description: Add another selected column while preserving SQL parameter binding. The input remains a separate argument, not executable SQL.

cases.title: Authorization negative control
cases.description: Improve the forbidden message while retaining the cross-file ownership check and access boundary.

base.policy.go:
package fixture

func Owns(actorID, ownerID int) bool { return actorID == ownerID }

cases.title: Documentation negative control
cases.description: Change only README text in a tiny compilable Go module.

head.README.md:
# Example API

A small API with explicit ownership checks.

cases.title: Sanitized child environment negative control
cases.description: Append a fixed non-sensitive test flag after sanitization; no credential is forwarded into the child.
